The suite was failing because `tax()` in `invoicing/pricing.py` charged tax on the full subtotal. Its docstring and the tests both say tax applies after the discount. I changed it to tax `subtotal - discount`. That was the only change.

All 17 tests pass now. Before the fix, the two failures were `test_tax_applies_after_discount` and `test_total_with_discount_and_tax`. For a UK invoice with a 200.00 subtotal and a 25% discount, the tax was 40.00 instead of 30.00.
